title: Regen root_authorization.json DODAGIDs to upstream AddrForKey + flip test oracle
description: Discovered-from 1p2r.4 (root_signature.json regen). test/vectors/root_authorization.json still carries rejected native-profile DODAGIDs (02ed4242ead4ac69... for pubkey 03a107bf...). Consumers: python/tests/test_protocol_vector_security.py:458 loop via native _addr_for_key helper (stale-but-green per 1p2r comment), rust/lichen-link/tests/root_authorization_vectors.rs, lichen/tests/coap_config/src/main.c. Fix: regen DODAGIDs to upstream AddrForKey(pubkey) (oracle: pinned yggdrasil_address.json anchor / independent bit-pack reimplementation, never impl-derived), flip the Python loop to _upstream_addr_for_key, and migrate Rust/C consumer expectations in the same pass so no tree goes red. When this lands, native _addr_for_key in test_protocol_vector_security.py has one consumer left (authenticated_schc_dio.json line-361 binding).
